1162.question: As per the India State of Forest Report 2021, dense forest (very dense + moderately dense) covers about what percentage of India's total geographical area?
1162.explanation: ISFR 2021: very dense forest 3.04% + moderately dense forest 9.33% = 12.37% of the geographical area (open forest is a further 9.34%). Hence about 12%.

1176.question: Under the Indian Forest Act, 1927, which of the following is the most appropriate sequence showing the degree of protection given to different forest types?
1176.explanation: The Indian Forest Act, 1927 provides the highest protection to Reserved Forests (most activities prohibited unless permitted), then Protected Forests (activities allowed unless prohibited), then Village Forests (assigned to village communities). Hence Reserved > Protected > Village.
1176.why: Stem was truncated (APPSC 2023 question); explanation completed.
